placement_alignment_bug_fix.description: The reported bug where 'placement of new tiles/objects did not line up with ground tiles' has been completely resolved. Root cause was terrain tiles drawn centered on grid corners while previews/fences/buildings used tile centers (half-tile diagonal offset). The fix in renderer.js drawTileOff now centers tiles on (x+0.5, y+0.5).

testing_methodology.canvas_testing_technique: Used window.__game.state for authoritative sim state and window.__gameRenderer for camera. Computed exact screen coordinates for tile centers using formula: wx=(x+0.5-y-0.5)*32, wy=(x+0.5+y+0.5)*16-h*10, then sx=wx*zoom+cam.x, sy=wy*zoom+cam.y. This ensures clicks land on exact tile centers matching the fixed rendering.
testing_methodology.state_verification: All tool interactions verified by checking state arrays (heights, materials, water, paths) before and after clicks to confirm exact tile modification.
testing_methodology.visual_verification: Screenshots captured at zoom 1.5 to verify blueprint preview diamonds align exactly with rendered terrain tile faces.
testing_methodology.weather_testing: Forced weather states via page.evaluate on window.__game.state (weather object + tick) to test specific conditions deterministically.
testing_methodology.tutorial_testing: Cleared localStorage flag before test to simulate first-time user, then verified all navigation flows and flag persistence.

test_environment.test_duration: ~8 minutes total across all test scripts
